cap_confirmation: driver state level_cap 100; Milotic/Togekiss offset 2 L100, Spiritomb/Lucario/Miraidon offset 3 L101, Garchomp offset 4 L102 = cap+offset-2 on Medium.
chronology_note: Post-game after the Champion, pool-100 fully open; no gate-100 species. Three reachable legends (Ting-Lu, Chien-Pao, Chi-Yu); no Intimidate/Snarl brought so Competitive never fires. See the manifest availability audit.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Togekiss Follow Me pulls single-target attacks; Air Slash 60% flinch; Thunder Wave
Milotic Competitive punishes stat drops; Recover
Spiritomb Foul Play / Will-O-Wisp / Snarl, no weaknesses
Miraidon Hadron Engine Electric Terrain on entry, Specs Electro Drift
Mega Garchomp Z custom form (source: pure Dragon, 130/85/151 Atk/Def/Spe, Rough Skin)

attempts.why: t1-t2 spread Rock Slide + Dazzling Gleam through Follow Me did little: Milotic Recovered and Togekiss Thunder Waved Flutter Mane. t3 Ruination halved Togekiss, Scald 202 on Ting-Lu. t4 Togekiss and Ting-Lu both Protected. t5 Overheat KO'd Togekiss (Follow Me pulled it anyway); Scald 195 on Chi-Yu. t6 Milotic Protected Wood Hammer, Foul Play 215 on Rillaboom. t7 Milotic's second Protect failed and Grassy Glide KO'd it; Icicle Crash flinched Spiritomb. t8 AI switched Spiritomb for Miraidon into Wood Hammer (Electric Terrain replaced Grassy), Sacred Sword OHKO'd Scarf Lucario. t9 Specs Electro Drift KO'd Rillaboom, Icicle Crash OHKO'd Miraidon. t10 Mega Garchomp Z (151 Speed) outsped Chien-Pao and Rock Slided both, Icicle Crash KO'd Spiritomb, crit Surging Strikes (resisted: the Z form is pure Dragon) took Garchomp to 144. t11 Ice Shard KO'd it. Faints: Rillaboom.

protect_summary: 3 Protects: two good, one failed consecutive attempt.
ai_notes: Sound: Follow Me every turn a single-target threat existed, Recover at the right time, the Spiritomb-for-Miraidon switch absorbed a Wood Hammer at a resistance and set Electric Terrain over Grassy. Togekiss never clicked Air Slash (the plan's 'highest-value click') in five turns - it preferred Follow Me/Thunder Wave/Protect, all reasonable.
level_change_rationale: Won first try 6-1 in 10 turns with a single faint. Per the brief, +1 on the two weakest members (the offset-2 support lead); Spiritomb/Lucario/Miraidon and the Mega untouched.
cooler: The final boss is coherent and every phase appeared. Togekiss carrying Air Slash but never using it is the one gap - if the AI will not click it, Follow Me + Thunder Wave + Protect + Air Slash is effectively a three-move set. Species/sets unchanged in this pass.
